text_to_image_prompt: Premium refined semi-realistic 2.5D/3D character render, sculpted beautiful face, delicate skin microtexture and subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, fine individual hair strands, richly detailed fabric and metal physically based materials. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with fill, no colored cast, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Preserve CG material finish, not a photograph or flat illustration. An adult man with long dark silver-gray hair half swept up beneath an intricate silver crystal crown, blue-gray eyes, pale cool skin, a refined oval face and muted rose lips. Small silver jeweled forehead ornament and long silver earrings. Icy white and pale blue ornate high-collar fantasy robes with fine translucent layers over an opaque base, silver embroidery and a blue crystal clasp. Continue the white pale-blue fantasy robe into a long ankle-length outer robe with translucent silver embroidered layers over a fully opaque light-blue underrobe, blue jeweled waist sash, white silver embroidered boots. Tall 189 cm slender masculine build. Exactly three equally spaced full-body views of ONE SAME person in one horizontal row: strict FRONT at left, strict 90-degree SIDE profile facing image-left in center, strict 180-degree BACK at right. Consistent identity, clothing, hairstyle, shoes and 8.5-head tall long-limbed anatomy. Relaxed straight upright stance arms by sides. Every figure fully visible from hair to soles with margin, identical height, same baseline. Pure white ground, narrow white gutters, landscape 3:2. No text.
